instruction: Look at plate_100x60x12.step in NX CAM. Create a Milling CAM setup. Define rectangular blank with 2 mm extension on all X/Y sides and 1 mm extension in Z+. Set the MCS origin at the blank top-face center with Z upward. Use T1, a 16 mm face mill, to create a Face Milling operation targeting final top face Z=12.000 mm with S6000 rpm and F800 mm/min. Tool definition: T1 is a 16 mm face mill for Face Milling, S6000 rpm, F800 mm/min. Write the required output file(s) using exactly these Desktop path(s): C:\Users\User\Desktop\task-1.nc. You must complete all operations interactively through the graphical user interface (GUI) step by step. The use of external script files is strictly prohibited.
